## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3 (Phase E slice): touchpoint review-artifact test passes asserting cycles[] for preplanning Phase E
- dd-6 (Phase E slice): single ticket comment per cycle references artifact path (not cycle body) — Phase E

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test + edit SKILL.md — Gate 2)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md (Edit — Phase E re-dispatch block)
- tests/scripts/test-preplanning-phase-e-cycles.sh (Create)

## Implementation Notes
Edit preplanning/SKILL.md Phase E re-dispatch block (added by story b345-913f-29d7-4ee9) to call append_review_cycle.py after each cycle, then emit a single ticket comment referencing artifact path. Add inline prose: comment MUST reference artifact path and MUST NOT duplicate cycle body.

Shell pattern to add after each Phase E re-dispatch:
python3 plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py --artifact <path> --n <n> --draft-hash <hash> --findings-count <count> --verdict <verdict>
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <ticket-id> "Remediation cycle <n> recorded at <artifact-path>"

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-preplanning-phase-e-cycles.sh exists and is executable
2. Test asserts Phase E SKILL.md block contains append_review_cycle.py invocation
3. Test asserts Phase E SKILL.md contains ticket comment invocation following the append
4. Test asserts prose forbids duplicating cycle body in comment
5. grep -q 'append_review_cycle.py' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found
6. grep -q 'ticket comment' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found
7. grep -qi 'not duplicat\|references the artifact path' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found
8. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-preplanning-phase-e-cycles.sh → PASS
data.title: Wire cycles[] append + single-comment policy into preplanning Phase E re-dispatch block
